additionalCheckpoint.scope: On-disk settings only; game memory/closed-client state not asserted. No settings writes, profiling changes, or game input.

behavior: One public addon-owned Font object updates existing native duration text out of combat; settings changes in combat defer. Buff grid right and debuff grid left, three columns/two rows maximum, zero icon and row gaps. Black outline plus opaque black shadow. Optional auraTimersUnderMinute=false by default in both scopes blanks numbers at60seconds and above, retaining icons/swipes/stacks.
implementation: Attach shared font/formatter once before native ownership; refresh only public Font/NumericRuleFormatter objects. No native descendant reads/mutations or restricted-duration comparison. Shared formatter is used by native duration bindings and readable/preview cooldown countdowns; original seconds-formatter fallback retained. Aura X scale still requires reload.

sourceEvidence.method: Fresh pinned GitHub connector fetches on all five branches confirm Font:SetFont and C_StringUtil.CreateNumericRuleFormatter; cached five-client Cooldown:SetCountdownFormatter accepts NumericFormatter. Native SetDurationText uses formatter references.
